race.comment: IMPETUOUSLY (7) clocked a fast 19.15 when filling a minor placing over 350m at this track last start. Expected to go close again if runs up to latest time. ESPECIAL KAI (2) goes very well this trip starting 45 times for 15 wins and 20 minors. Missed the frame latest (19.41) when fifth over 350m at this track in a Free For All. Can feature in the finish. EVIL EYE (1) was out of the placings last time but shapes well for this on his solid win the start prior, getting around this track over 350m in 19.28. Expecting another bold showing. LEWIS (3) scored last time and appeals as a top-three prospect.
